{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A wool-blend coat in charcoal grey (#3a4548), a relaxed straight fit falling to mid-calf length, heavy enough for deep frost.
Dark denim trousers with a tapered leg in indigo (#2f3b49), straight cut with reinforced stitching for durability against cobblestones.
A chunky knit scarf in cream white (#fdfdfd) wrapped loosely around the neck to block wind.
Leather ankle boots in black (#1c1c1c), lace-up style with a 3cm heel and thick rubber soles for grip on snowy, salted surfaces.
This outfit works because the wool-blend coat provides essential warmth against the -15°C frost while protecting her from snow, satisfying her request to avoid open zones. The dark denim offers practical durability and comfort for walking to work on slippery cobblestones without sacrificing style. Finally, the black leather boots ensure stability and traction in icy conditions, completing a look that is both functional and respectful of her casual dress code."}
